test_replacement_rule: Replace only a failed precommitted data-quality gate, using the next quality-passing replacement in ascending lap order. Never replace based on model residual, strategy outcome or lap pace. Retain every rejection reason.

data_quality.metadata_filter: Legacy clean-lap check: exclude start/warmup, pit in/out window, yellow/red/SC/VSC including ending buffer, deleted lap, rainfall/missing weather, unverified dry compound, anomalous duration and missing/inconsistent sector times.

geometry_protocol.method: Freeze previously prepared legacy geometry and approximate aero endpoints, with source and derived SHA256 verification; both were fitted using calibration laps 3-6 only.
geometry_protocol.test_location_use: Transform and project each test lap with frozen calibration transform solely to align observations for scoring; never refit geometry, phase, aero endpoints or vehicle parameters using test laps.

information_boundary.previously_inspected: Laps 7 and 9 and their v1 residuals have been inspected. They are development data for v2. Full-session lap/sector metadata for candidate laps 10-18 has also been inspected; their complete speed/location arrays and model residuals have not.
information_boundary.test_status: New unused telemetry holdout within the same event, driver and tyre stint; not a wholly blind event or circuit test.
information_boundary.development_loader: load_dataset_v2(include_test=False) excludes all test arrays, lap times and sector labels. Only selection identities and quality-gate diagnostics remain visible in audit.
information_boundary.selection: Model, hyperparameter and checkpoint selection use calibration/development only. Freeze those artifacts before a single final test scoring pass, and report all selected test laps.
information_boundary.ers_labels: Actual SOC, DC deployment and active aero state are unavailable; observed speed does not uniquely identify them.

accuracy_gate.status: Prospective research acceptance targets frozen before new telemetry download; not FIA requirements. This data protocol alone does not certify model accuracy.
accuracy_gate.speed_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of each complete lap's speed RMSE, with equal lap weight; do not pool all resampled points across laps.
accuracy_gate.development_gate: Calibration convergence, implemented physical/rule-subset checks and all three accuracy criteria on development laps 7/9 are required before formal ML training. If the development gate fails, finish implementation/tests and score the newly reserved final test exactly once with the frozen diagnostic model; report failure rather than relax thresholds.
required_metrics: per-lap absolute circle-time error in percent
all three absolute sector-time errors in seconds
forbidden_claims: Real team SOC or deployment reconstruction
Real-world lap-time gain inferred from model gain

calibration_experiment.objective: Equal-weight normalized speed error (15 km/h), lap-time error (0.02 * real lap duration) and sector-time error (1 s), plus a fixed prior; calibration laps only.
calibration_experiment.downstream_freeze: Freeze model weights, selected vehicle, model/control configuration, geometry/rules/protocol hashes and source code hashes in a separate experiment lock before load_dataset_v2(include_test=True).

limitations: Same driver, stint and event only; later laps have different fuel and tyre age, and traffic/actual ERS/Overtake may differ.
Planar historical minimum-curvature route and approximate aero regions are inherited; this protocol does not resolve those model limitations.
Raw speed precision and approximate location alignment remain unchanged; interpolation does not increase measurement precision.
